key.name: codex-panel-window
key.summary: Codex window shown in the panel
key.description: Which Codex limit the panel number reflects: the 5-hour window, the weekly window, or whichever has the least left.

key.name: claude-panel-window
key.summary: Claude window shown in the panel
key.description: Which Claude limit the panel number reflects: the 5-hour window, the weekly window, or whichever has the least left.

key.name: panel-value
key.description: Whether the panel numbers show the percentage that is left or the percentage that is used. The popup always shows percent used.

key.name: color-thresholds
key.description: Green above 50% left, yellow between 20% and 50%, red below 20%.

key.name: auto-refresh-tokens
key.description: When a stored access token has expired, exchange the refresh token for a new one and write it back to the login file, the same way the CLIs do.

key.name: codex-auth-path
key.description: Path to the Codex CLI auth.json. Leave empty to use $CODEX_HOME/auth.json or ~/.codex/auth.json.

key.name: claude-credentials-path
key.description: Path to the Claude Code .credentials.json. Leave empty to use $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.credentials.json or ~/.claude/.credentials.json.
